verdict.rationale: Vanta publishes a per-endpoint API reference (list tests, controls, contracts, business units), and the controls reference describes a server dropdown used to "issue requests" against the API, which indicates an interactive try-it console. Only that single line evidences interactivity, so the depth of the runnable experience is unproven. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of runnable code samples or a try-it playground across endpoints, a publicly fetchable OpenAPI spec (common paths returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: Select `Vanta Gov (FedRAMP)` from the server dropdown to issue requests against `https://api.vanta-gov.com`.
